regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-narrative commodity-leaning TSX: Oil & Gas Producers lead (eligible, crowded, mixed hurst), with Base Metals & Copper a close challenger. Rotation is broad (56% eligible) but not directional, one-narrative is false, and the only validated edge is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true). Directional accuracy on past calls is weak (0.347), so leans here are humble conditionals, not predictions.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Base Metals & Copper closes the rotation margin to Oil & Gas Producers (currently 0.223) AND its durability_bar rises above 0.60 while remaining eligible — that would mark a confirmed handoff worth separately leaning into; if the margin widens back above 0.4 or XBM turns ineligible, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the prevailing narrative, eligible and the top-ranked theme with moderate durability (0.62) and reasonable breadth (0.643). Crowding (z=1.01) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Given the validated gate is drawdown control rather than return edge, an overweight lean here is simply staying with the confirmed leader while respecting that the rank itself has no forward alpha.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership on the TSX is often a high-beta oil-price beta trade; the mixed hurst tag suggests the trend is not cleanly persistent, and a sharp oil selloff would hit XEG hard regardless of thematic leadership.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 4% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: XBM.TO is the strongest challenger with the second-highest momentum score, eligible, and not crowded (z=0.89). The margin to the leader is narrow (0.223), but the rotation radar is not directional and the detector has no validated handoff timing, so I treat this as a secondary exposure to the same commodity complex rather than a rotation bet.
theses.dissent: Base metals have a mean-revert hurst tag, implying recent strength may not persist beyond a few weeks; copper prices are tightly linked to global growth expectations which could turn if macro data softens.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO gives back its last 10 trading days of relative gains versus XEG.TO before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: XUT.TO is ineligible (below the absolute-trend gate) with a negative score and low breadth (0.167). The one validated edge of the detector is avoiding shake-outs via this gate, so an avoid lean on an ineligible, weak-breadth theme is the most defensible call the state supports.
theses.dissent: Utilities are defensive bond proxies; if risk sentiment deteriorates broadly, this could be the one place that holds up, making an avoid lean wrong in a risk-off tape.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO outperforms XEG.TO by more than 5% over the next 15 trading days before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
